inlines.v: CRAFTINESS, noun Artfulness; dexterity in devising and effecting a purpose; cunning; artifice; stratagem. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness Job 5:13. Not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully. 2 Corinthians 4:2.
